description: Deterministic benchmark goals for the Forge harness eval gate (Phase 6). Each goal is small enough to complete in under 15 minutes on a local model and has a known-good contract.

goals.title: Implement FizzBuzz with tests
goals.description: Write fizzbuzz(n) returning Fizz/Buzz/FizzBuzz/n and a pytest suite covering n=1..15.

goals.title: Adversarial: naive contract would be vacuous
goals.description: Goal whose obvious acceptance test (`python -c 'import os'`) is vacuous; exercises Phase 2 (contract immune system) — the auditor must derive a non-vacuous contract.
success_criteria: a real artifact is produced and independently checkable

goals.title: Adversarial: contract includes a flaky test
goals.description: One acceptance test depends on unordered dict iteration and flakes; exercises Phase 1 (flake weighting) so the run still converges instead of stalling on the flake.
success_criteria: flaky test does not block convergence

goals.title: Small CLI argument parser with tests
goals.description: Parse --name/--count flags; unit tests via node --test.

goals.title: String reversal utility with a test binary
goals.description: Implement reverse_string() and a small test executable asserting round-trip correctness.

goals.title: Word-count CLI with tests
goals.description: Count words from stdin; cargo test covers empty input and multi-line input.
